title: Groundhog faint grants a trumpet
covers: faint trigger with no pet target
notes: The only fixture that produces a trumpets log. The Groundhog dies on the first clash and its faint pays a trumpet to the player, which has no pet target, so this is the one event class with no source-to-target motion. Two friends are kept alive to the end so the Golden pack's last-stand Golden Retriever never spawns and the clip stays a pure trumpets case.
